snippet.title: Dr. Mancell and Mr. Flame (Waterflame x Crash Bandicoot Composer)
snippet.description:
Halloween collaboration with Josh Mancell, composer of the original Crash Bandicoot! Just in time for the 30th anniversary (unintentionally)! BUT WAIT THERE'S MORE! WE MADE A FULL HOMAGE GAME TO GO WITH IT!  

PLAY THE GAME:
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5301420/Dr_Mancell_and_Mr_Flame/
NEWGROUNDS: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/project/8130027 

LIVESTREAMED DEMO: https://youtube.com/live/y1rjzrBlwDU?feature=share

The song itself is available as well:
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/album/1NWgJdGZvxzFXXcNL0vc7T?si=6yobSMk2TP2vY2rDSz8PRw
Apple: https://music.apple.com/album/6814763678
Bandcamp: https://autodidactic.bandcamp.com/track/dr-mancell-and-mr-flame-waterflame-vs-josh-mancell
Newgrounds: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1625479

Big thanks to Hoolopee for making the Animated Music Video!

Game Credits:
Produced by Autodidactic Studios
Developed by pftq
Music by Waterflame and Josh Mancell
3D Models and Animated Music Video by hoolopee
